name: Jasmine Juggs
source:
The hot-tempered police chief recently moved to Vesper as part of a transfer program that saw the young officer assume control of the local police department. Since she's arrived, she has ruled with an iron fist, earning a reputation for her no-nonsense approach and unwavering authority.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
